nina: Heads-up: onboarding sampleapp reproducible hiccup. Token rotate mid-scan causes SDK concurrency to collapse and paginator stalls. No 429s upstream but UX shows ~5s pause. Anyone run into this specific spiral?

chao: Which paginator variant? adaptive prefetch or fixed window?

nina: adaptive prefetch. Repro steps: 5 parallel clients, pageSize=60, force token refresh ~7s in. After refresh per-client slots drop from ~5 to 1 and outstanding fetches pile up.

morgan: That sounds like the clamp-on-auth heuristic doing its job too eagerly. The pump sees empty buffer and issues more fetches that then queue behind the clamp -> feedback loop.

nina: paste log snippet:
[2026-03-28T12:03:10Z] fetchPage(client=2,page=8) -> 200 (lat=90ms)
[2026-03-28T12:03:17Z] auth.refresh(client=2) -> 200
[2026-03-28T12:03:17Z] concurrency.adjust(client=2) old=5 new=1 reason=auth_rotate
[2026-03-28T12:03:17Z] prefetch.request(client=4,p=9) queued_count=6 wait=4.0s

chao: Proposed fixes: (1) don't clamp below 20-25% of previous window on successful auth. (2) make prefetch target proportional to current window so pump doesn't overshoot.

morgan: Also consider a short "soft credit" period after successful refresh: grant a couple of immediate dispatch credits (250-400ms) so the pipeline can clear without dropping everything to 1. Revoke if errors start appearing.

nina: agree. I'd add telemetry: track "auth-induced-clamp" events and correlate with prefetch queue depth to prove causality.

replay-bot: Note created: TICKET-DX-4432 "sdk: reduce auth clamp + add soft credits to avoid prefetch spiral" with logs attached.

chao: test plan: deterministic integration that advances clock, forces TTL expiry mid-iteration across 5 clients, assert mean queue-time <2.5s and 99th <6s. Add env flags SDK_AUTH_GRACE_MS and SDK_PREFETCH_SCALE for experiments.

morgan: I'll draft the PR to change clamp heuristic and implement soft credits and proportional prefetch. I'll default conservative values and gate behind an env flag.

nina: after PRs land run sampleapp-load (https://ci.internal/redwood/sampleapp-load) and watch per-client dispatch wait histogram + prefetch buffer fill. If still bad we can relax clamp or increase grace window.

chao: also add a short note in onboarding docs: "token rotation during heavy paginated scans may interact with client-side backpressure; consider refresh margin >30s during load tests."

nina: thanks all, will post PR/CI links here once ready. :sparkles:
